mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 20 trading days signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates on equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% in the next month triggers investor concerns about labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) and concurrent decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable demand-easing environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 up and FEDFUNDS down.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 105) in an expanding economy signals robust supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 270 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 270 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL crossing threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in HOUST (demand for thousands of units) indicates strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite HOUST trending up.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with rising labor demand (PAYEMS) creates a favorable labor market environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p > 0.05) when UNRATE down and PAYEMS up.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by elevated HOUST (demand), investors anticipate prolonged growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when HOUST > 1500.
